messages.subject: Absolute path error
parts:
I'm trying to deploy my app to shinyapps.io and I am receiving the following error:

The following lines contain absolute paths:
920:       withMathJax(sprintf("\\(\\mathbb{P}(X \\le x) = \\) %.03f corresponds to an \\(x\\) value of %.04f \\( = F^{-1}\\) (%.03f).",

I've tested the app after deployment on multiple machines and it seems to be running fine and executing this MathJax code just fine.  Can someone provide some insight into what this error means?  

The first and last %.03f corresponds to an inputted value in a numericInput box and the %.04f corresponds to a call to one of the distributional quantile functions (qDIST).

If there are better ways to write this output, I'd love to hear them as well.

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Absolute path error
parts:
Chester,

There seems to be a problem with how shinyapps package parses the code. I opened a ticket for that (https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps/issues/75). I could reproduce your problem with some simpler code that was valid.

I cannot comment on how to write a better output since I am not very familiar with that syntax. 

Best,
Fereshteh
